review_rule: Read every complete pre-event question and company reply before any fifth-cohort model output. Use only company-confirmed facts and the frozen v5 prompt ontology; keep conditional and incomplete states. Reject question-only rumors, routine shareholder counts, static capabilities and old disclosures without current progress. Each event must have a unique exact quote from the reply and each item its own substantive rationale. Do not use future prices, unseen disclosures or fifth-cohort model outputs.
score_interpretation: Agreement with a single AI source-first review on a fifth disjoint company sample, not human-ground-truth accuracy or market predictive validity.
